title: [29.X]-Production Order Fails to Finish Due to Quantity Rounding Difference Between Component Consumption and Item Tracking Quantity - Copy
summary: A production order can now be finished when the component consumption and the item tracking quantity differ only by rounding. The fix is a small change in Mfg. Cost Calculation Mgt., with a new test.
key_points: Production orders no longer fail to finish because of a rounding difference between consumption and item tracking quantities
Small change in the Mfg. Cost Calculation Mgt. codeunit
Test added in SCM Production Orders II
